quality.rationale: Open P2 backlog is implemented and verified with automated tests, production build, and headless Chromium runtime gate. Coverage includes the attached Blur stroke null.checked runtime error fix, SVG favicon, Adobe-style color wheel and palette bars, synchronized HEX/RGB palette input, recent colors, immediate color preview application, vertical text visual selection bounds, CSV/HTML persistence, local image import, WebP export, mobile no-overflow, user-facing docs, and QCDS evidence. Cross-browser, real-device, and browser storage quota edge cases remain future work.

Remaining satisfaction risk is storage quota behavior, broader real-user font files, and non-Chromium browser coverage.
